data.name: Banarsi
data.gender_notes: Banarsi is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Banarsi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ban' which means 'forest' and 'Asi' which means 'Lord Shiva'. This name is often given to those who are devoted to Lord Shiva and wish to live a life filled with his blessings. The name Banarsi carries the meaning “Worshipper of Lord Shiva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Banarsi usually hope their child will grow to embody worshipper of lord shiva and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.context: The city's historical significance is rooted in its ancient origins and its status as a major Hindu pilgrimage site. It is believed that the city was founded by Rishi Vishwamitra, who was a great sage and a guru in Hindu mythology. The city was also an important center of learning, attracting scholars, poets, and philosophers from across India and beyond.
